utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks—that’d be helpful. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so if you can check what they need most right now, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’d check on the leaky faucet first, then the porch step, and finish with the flickering hallway light. I’m probably running late again, but I can jump in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — that sounds really helpful. I’ll pass along that you can jump in wherever they need you most.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Mara—thank you. Please let everyone know we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone know we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer and a screwdriver I can bring by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect—thanks, Gus. Bring them by whenever you can, and I’ll be ready for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll drop by with the hammer and screwdriver soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Vik. Just let me know what’s needed for the repair drive, and I’ll do my best to help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’m still sorting the details, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out. Just point me to whatever needs fixing and I’ll try to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few tools and some screws ready to pass along, and I’m asking around for neighbors who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you can help sort the repair items and keep track of donations, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I can do that — I’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure the neighbors know. If you want, I can help round up a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — that’d help a lot. I’ll check with the organizers when I’m out and pass along the date once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — once you have the date, send it my way and I’ll get it around the block right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just give me the time and I’ll help haul the materials.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m waiting on the time and drop-off spot so I can sort out what needs to be brought.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll share the time and drop-off spot as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and remind folks to meet at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — Maple Street this Saturday works for me. I’ll start with the leaky faucet and keep the porch step and hallway light in mind.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Hana — I’ll make sure everyone knows to bring tools for those repairs. Thanks for jumping in on the faucet, porch step, and hallway light.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’m organizing the repair drive now and keeping track of what we need. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The porch light by the front steps sounds like the first thing to tackle. If you’ve got the bulb or ladder handy, I can take a look right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll check on the bulb and ladder right now. Thanks for jumping in; I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m checking on it now and I’ll ask what they want brought. I’ll let you know the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I really appreciate you checking and letting me know the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve got you — I’ll ask around and come back with the list and drop-off spot as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please—can you check what they need most right now? And did we already set the date for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll check what they need most and bring you a simple list. I don’t think we’ve set the date yet, so let’s confirm that next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Please confirm the date and let me know the top needs when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still able to help — I’ll sort the donations and keep an eye on the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — that’s a huge help. I’ll check the hardware store on Pine and the community center bulletin board for any repair-drive flyers, and I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let everyone on the block know about the repair drive, and I can help gather a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming—you’re still able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, absolutely — I’m still in and happy to help with the repair drive. I’ll keep spreading the word and round up a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll pass that along and mention tools or even just an hour would help a lot. Anything specific you want me to tell folks to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Please tell folks to bring any tools they have, plus an hour if they can spare it. I’m still sorting the details, and I’ll keep everyone posted on what’s needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—I’ll tell everyone to bring whatever tools they have and an hour if they can spare it. Let me know when the details are set, and I’ll pass those along too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll bring the list by, and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks—what’s on the list? I can help with the next repair.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll jot down the basics and keep it tidy. We can match the next repair to whatever you’re best at.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll start with the leaky faucet, and we can handle the porch step and hallway light after you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll plan around 3:30 to 5:00 and make sure it fits the pickup rush.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, thanks — I’ll start on the faucet and keep the porch step and hallway light queued up for when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great — if you can check the latest list, I’d really appreciate it. I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so I’m not sure what they need most right now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can check the latest list. Just send me the main needs and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — the latest I heard was that they still need volunteers, a few tools, spare parts, and cash donations. If you can tell me what’s most needed right now, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure Dane and the others know we’re meeting at the repair drive spot on Maple Street this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be late as usual, but I’ll head to the Maple Street spot Saturday and jump in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — just come by when you can and we’ll find you a spot. Glad you’re in!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect — thanks, Gus. Just bring them by when you can, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’m still a bit worried about the drop-off spot and what’s actually needed, so please let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I might’ve missed the latest on the drop-off spot too, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — could you check the hardware store on Pine and the community center bulletin board for any repair-drive flyers? If you spot anything, just let me know where and when.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check both spots and let you know if I find any flyers. If they’re up, I’ll send the where and when.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. Please let me know what you find at the hardware store on Pine and the community center bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That would really help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that — I’ll sort the repair items and keep track of the donations.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would mean a lot, Sam. Thank you for helping with the donations and the sorting.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check on what they want brought and the drop-off spot, then I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — let me know when you hear back. If you find out the date too, send that along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around about the date, what to bring, and the drop-off spot, then I’ll pass it all along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think the porch light by the front steps is still the next thing we need fixed. Thanks for checking in, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep that porch light on the list and ask around for anyone else who needs help too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be a big help. I’m a little foggy, but if anyone spots another broken thing, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — bring the list by when you’ve got it, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll bring the list by soon and appreciate whatever you can spare. I’m still good for after school, around 3:30 to 5:00.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — 3:30 to 5:00 works for me, Mara. Bring the list by and I’ll see what tools I can set aside.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
